environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB. Database connections routed through PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode (pool_mode=transaction). PostgreSQL 15.4 with default transaction isolation level (read committed). No rate limiting on /transfer endpoint. Multiple service replicas (desired_count=4) hitting the same PgBouncer instance. PgBouncer max_client_conn=400, default_pool_size=40.
